invariants.rationale: fontName is used to retrieve a font from skin, empty or null might cause failure.
colorName is used to retrieve a color from skin, empty or null might cause failure.
text may be null (as allowed by @Null), but otherwise must be a CharSequence with non-negative length.
fontName is used in skin.getFont, which likely requires non-null argument.
colorName is used in skin.getColor, which likely requires non-null argument.
